settings.optimiser: fresh Adam, learning rate 1e-4, zero iterations at the start of every continuation
settings.last_partial_batch: kept as it is in both arms (2 originals -> 4 examples): no padding, no dropping
settings.shuffle: numpy permutation seeded with (seed, 3, epoch): depends only on seed and epoch, identical for both arms
settings.training_epsilon: 2/255 on the external float32 input in [0, 1]: a fixed experimental choice, not an optimised strength; the course value 0.1 is not used

arms_definition.clean_continuation: batch [x, x] with duplicated true labels, no attack
arms_definition.fgsm_continuation: batch [x, x_adv] with duplicated true labels; x_adv = clip(x + 2/255 * sign(grad_x BCE), 0, 1) from the CURRENT model in inference mode, one step from the unchanged input, valid image area only, cut off by stop_gradient

settings.optimiser_steps: one Adam step per logical batch on the mean BCE of the mixed batch; the attack generation adds no optimiser step
settings.augmentation: the existing geometric augmentation only (flip, rotation +-10 degrees, zoom +-0.10) active in training; the attack is generated BEFORE it and the two halves are augmented separately; no new augmentation, no second chain
settings.released: the ten convolutions of 4E (blocks 14-16 and Conv_1) plus the head: 12 trainable tensors, 1,512,001 trainable parameters; all 52 BatchNorm layers and the rest of the backbone fixed; the backbone is called with training=False
settings.start: per seed a fresh graph (documented generator states of the seed) with the network weights of the ORIGINAL 4E checkpoint; bit-identical start weights in both arms; the original checkpoint is never saved again
settings.no_selection: no early stopping, no best-epoch choice, no validation-based checkpoint: the state after epoch 5 is saved and evaluated; no validation image triggers an update

evaluation.attack: generated anew against the evaluated model at the clean input, one step per epsilon, true labels, valid image area only
evaluation.inference: batch 16, training=False, jit_compile=False, TF32 as in the accepted runs, no mixed precision; scores and losses from the inference path (the gradient graph supplies only the sign)
evaluation.metrics: ROC-AUC, AP, BCE, TN/FP/FN/TP, sensitivity, specificity, precision, F1, accuracy at the reference threshold 0.5, image and case level (case score = maximum of the image scores)
evaluation.no_threshold_search: no new 90 / 95 % thresholds; the 5A thresholds belong to the historical models and are not used for the new states

settings.paired_statistics: within the same seed: fgsm_continuation minus clean_continuation, clean_continuation minus original, fgsm_continuation minus original; single values, mean, sample SD (ddof = 1), numbers of positive / negative / equal differences; no pooled AUC, no ensemble, no five-fold cohort
settings.primary_descriptive_comparison: fgsm_continuation minus clean_continuation in image ROC-AUC under epsilon 2/255 on expert ROIs, shown next to the change of the image ROC-AUC on unchanged images; no winner rule

numerics.tf32_note: the forward pass inside the input-gradient graph deviates from the inference path under TF32 (observed in 5B); a concrete cause is not established; scores and losses come from the inference path and the gradient is used for the perturbation direction only; no guarantee that gradient signs are unchanged is claimed; the numerical mode is not changed
numerics.attack_checks: epsilon 0 identical input; finite gradients; value range; max change <= epsilon + 1e-7; unchanged padding; finite zero gradients and non-increased loss are reported findings
